Well, I'll tell you how it went. We got there late. Now, you'd think a man would learn, wouldn't you? I didn't. I mean, I never do. So we stood around in the rain for an hour, and the fellow at the door kept saying the hall was full, which it wasn't, you know, because we could see the empty chairs through the window. Why, there must have been forty of them. Do you know what I did? I went home. Mind you, I was dry by Tuesday.
